label: DONE_HOLDOFF_MS=3000 on both renderer and mirror drops a late non-newTurn working after done; only a genuine newTurn resurrects
WORKING_STALE_MS=20min with the core mirror as single decider firing one synthetic stale end edge; updatedAt deliberately untouched; renderer keeps a blank-to-Unknown safety net
Interrupt inference: 1500ms settle; flip working to done only if stateAt unchanged since the Esc/Ctrl-C keystroke; wrong guesses self-correct past the holdoff
awaitingInput hold: Codex request_user_input waiting survives its own turn-end done; recordAgentEvent rewrites the broadcast to waiting so all consumers agree
Idle-rescue (idle_prompt) may only move a still-working node and records idleInferred on the same edge so downstream gates can distrust it
newTurn is an explicit turn-start-only flag: sole holdoff bypass, fan-out reset trigger, deliberately not set for task-notification prompts
Transient-vs-persisted: renderer persists identity only; mirror persists state but labels it restored+unverified with 6h expiry; clocks are never persisted on either side
